subject: Working Joe
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-pose pelvis center at the proximal leg junction, projected vertically to the physical planted-boot support or collapsed body/limb contact. Anchor y equals the complete current extraction lower guard sourceBounds[3], so sourceBounds[3]-anchorY=0 for all 40 poses. Hands, skull, reach, corpse width and whole-body extrema never choose anchor x.
